description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Basecamp to-dos in a target to-do list. Rows are matched to existing to-dos by a key marker embedded in the to-do description (e.g. <!-- dagster-key: INC-1001 -->); Basecamp has no native upsert endpoint for to-dos.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Basecamp to-do (upserted via key_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Basecamp.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

todolist_id.label: Todolist Id
todolist_id.description: Target Basecamp to-do list ID to-dos are created/matched in.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column holding a stable unique key, embedded as a dagster-key marker in the to-do description.

content_column.label: Content Column
content_column.description: Column holding the to-do's title text (Basecamp calls this field `content`, not `title`).

due_on_column.label: Due On Column
due_on_column.description: Column holding an ISO-8601 due date.

assignee_ids_column.label: Assignee Ids Column
assignee_ids_column.description: Column holding Basecamp person IDs to assign. Accepts a list, or a comma-separated string of ints.

completed_column.label: Completed Column
completed_column.description: Column holding a boolean/'true'/'false'. Toggles completion via Basecamp's separate completion sub-resource.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows to process per run (safety cap).

name: Basecamp To-do Upsert
